C1838.title: Wuhan Courier Exploited Platform Rule Loophole to Drain 430,000 Yuan in Deposit Funds, Convicted of Duty Encroachment
C1838.summary: Starting in 2017, Mr. Cui founded Ruiyang Company and franchised with Hongsheng Express, opening a deposit account per agreement. Courier Peng used the "Cainiao Parcel Hero" app to manipulate others' accounts into initiating parcel orders and altered parcel weights, triggering Cainao's deduction mechanism to quietly drain nearly 430,000 yuan from Ruiyang's deposit over six months. In June 2025, Wuhan Jianghan District People's Court convicted Peng of duty encroachment, sentencing him to two years' imprisonment plus a 30,000 yuan fine, with restitution ordered. The case is typical of exploiting platform withdrawal and deposit-deduction rules for profit.
